recordId.title: Record Id
recordId.description: Id of the record to update.

fieldValues.title: Field Values
fieldValues.description: The fields to set, as a JSON object of field API names and values, for example {"Status": "Escalated"}.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Why you are making this change, in plain language. The record owner will read this.

agentId.title: Agent Id
agentId.description: Your agent identifier. Use the same value in every AgentLedger action.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Optional one-line headline for the log. Leave blank to generate it from the change.

sessionId.title: Session Id
sessionId.description: Optional. Leave blank: your open AgentLedger run is used, or a new one is started.
